content: DoIP shall support USDT and UUDT messages according to ISO 14229-5 Description: DoIP module shall support both the interface-API (for UUDT) and the transport layer API towards the PduR for USDT. Rationale: DoIP shall be able to route both USDT (Unacknowledged segmented data transfer) and UUDT (Unacknowledged unsegmented data transfer) messages. Use Case: Routing of USDT and UUDT messages AppliesTo: AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: [2] ISO 14229-5
